utterance: I keep saying I'll write the book but I never start.

tension.T: Protecting the idea from judgment
tension.A: I'll write the book someday
tension.T+: Let the idea mature before testing it
tension.T-: Keep it only imagined, never risked
tension.A+: Draft pages, let them be imperfect
tension.A-: Force out pages just to prove motion

transformation.Ac: Intervention here means stepping into the gap between protecting the idea and actually risking it on paper.
transformation.Re: Treat the endless 'someday I'll write it' as a signal to decode, not just a feeling to soothe.
transformation.Ac+: Invert the goal: write to discard pages, not to produce a finished book.
transformation.Ac-: Keep refining the idea in your head, mistaking endless incubation for progress instead of writing.
transformation.Re+: Interpret their quiet ripening practice as proof the idea is ready to be drafted and discarded.
transformation.Re-: Keep interpreting their calm ripening as license to leave your own idea only imagined, never risked.

utterance: Our church should stop accepting donations from the casino owner.

tension.T: Stop accepting donations from casino owner
tension.A: Keep accepting, use influence to engage him
tension.T+: Decline funds while staying pastorally engaged with him
tension.T-: Cut off all contact, treat him as untouchable
tension.A+: Accept funds, direct them toward addiction recovery ministry
tension.A-: Take any money regardless of its harm

transformation.Ac: Restructuring church policy to stop accepting casino donations while shaping how refusal is enacted.
transformation.Re: Simply noticing that continuing to accept his gifts keeps the relationship and his money both in view.

transformation.Ac-: Once donations are routed to recovery ministry, the church quietly accepts all his money, unexamined.
transformation.Re+: Watch how pairing decline with pastoral invitation keeps the relationship alive, not just the money accounted for.
transformation.Re-: Admiring his pastoral invitation from a distance, you never act, and contact quietly dies anyway.

tension.T: Driving preserves his independence, identity
tension.A: He should stop driving now
tension.T+: New mobility options that keep him free
tension.T-: Keeps driving despite real danger signs
tension.A+: Safety ensured while honoring his independence
tension.A-: Forcing him off the road, no say

transformation.Ac: Aligning medical checks, family input, and his wishes into one coordinated, non-adversarial safety plan.
transformation.Re: Placing his need to keep driving within the wider context of what independence actually requires.
transformation.Ac+: Book a standard vision and reflex screening together, framing it as routine care, not judgment.
transformation.Ac-: Booking the screening behind his back turns routine care into an ambush that strips his say.
transformation.Re+: See their rides and errands as proof safety and independence can coexist, not as replacement.
transformation.Re-: Taking comfort in their errand runs while avoiding the real conversation lets dangerous driving continue.

utterance: I should confront my neighbour about the noise.

tension.T-: Confront harshly, demanding, escalating things
tension.A+: Understand their side, preserve the relationship
tension.A-: Stay silent while resentment quietly builds

transformation.Ac: Stepping in directly to address the noise, moving from confronting toward letting it go.
transformation.Re: Reading what their quiet or their words about the noise actually signal underneath.

transformation.Ac-: You raise it calmly once, hear no change, then quietly swallow all further complaints.
transformation.Re+: Interpret their logged times and factual tone as genuine invitation, not evidence against you.
transformation.Re-: You keep admiring their calm factual approach while your own words turn demanding and sharp.

utterance: We need to raise prices, we're too cheap.

tension.T: Keep prices low to win more customers
tension.A: We're too cheap, must raise prices
tension.T+: Low prices build broad loyal customer base
tension.T-: Underprice endlessly chasing volume, margins collapse
tension.A+: Raise prices to fund better value delivered
tension.A-: Hike prices blindly, alienate and lose customers

transformation.Ac: Executing the move from low-price positioning to deliberately higher, value-justified pricing.
transformation.Re: Noticing patterns in how their price pilot unfolds before drawing conclusions.
transformation.Ac+: Raise prices slightly on one product line, measure response before wider rollout.
transformation.Ac-: Roll out price hikes across every line at once, trusting the loyal base to absorb it.
transformation.Re+: Watch how their segment pilot plays out to spot early signs guiding your own rollout pace.
transformation.Re-: Keep analyzing their pilot data indefinitely while your own prices stay low and volume chases nothing.

tension.A: Keep the security and craft of employed work

tension.T-: Quitting abruptly with no runway or validation
tension.A+: Employment funds and de-risks building the company

transformation.Ac: Arranging income, time, and savings so quitting becomes a structured transition, not a leap.

tension.A: Stop giving free advice to friends who don't act

tension.T-: Keep advising anyway while quietly feeling drained
tension.A+: Give advice freely, released from needing it used

transformation.Re-: Endlessly reinterpreting their silence as fine while still advising, drained, until resentment hardens.
